title: The C string functions
hints: Every function here is "move a pointer until you find the zero". For `myStrcmp`, stop at the first difference or at the end of `a`, then subtract the two characters as `unsigned char`.
For `myStrstr`, try each starting position in the haystack; from each one, walk a second pointer through the needle while the characters match. If you reach the needle's zero, you found it.
rules: Walk the strings with pointers instead of [ ].
Write the loops yourself instead of calling the library.
